name: Immunofluorescence Staining
description: Immunofluorescence (IF) staining of cells on coverslips for confocal or widefield fluorescence microscopy. Detects protein localization. Adjust antibody concentrations and permeabilization based on target.
source_note: General educational template for indirect immunofluorescence on adherent cells.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.description: Aspirate culture medium from cells grown on coverslips in well plates. Wash twice with room-temperature PBS to remove serum.
steps.notes: Cells should be 60–80% confluent on coverslips.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.description: Fix cells with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS. Incubate at room temperature. Fixation preserves cellular morphology and antigen epitopes.
steps.notes: Methanol fixation (−20°C, 10 min) can also be used — it simultaneously permeabilizes. PFA is preferred for preserving cell structure. For many nuclear antigens, methanol fixation works well.
steps.warnings: PFA is toxic and a potential carcinogen. Work in fume hood. Dispose as chemical waste.

steps.title: Wash with PBS
steps.description: Wash cells 3 times with PBS to remove fixative. Allow 5 min per wash.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells (for intracellular targets)
steps.description: Permeabilize cell membranes with 0.1–0.2% Triton X-100 or 0.1% saponin in PBS. Incubate briefly. Skip for surface-only staining.
steps.notes: Triton X-100 permeabilizes all membranes. For nuclear staining: 0.5% Triton for 5 min. For mitochondrial markers: 0.1% for 10 min.

steps.title: Blocking
steps.description: Block non-specific binding with 5–10% normal serum (from the same species as secondary antibody) or 1–5% BSA in PBST. Incubate on a gentle rocker.

reagents.name: Blocking buffer (5% normal goat serum or 3% BSA in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100)

steps.notes: Use serum from the same species as secondary antibody. Blocking at 4°C overnight also works.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.description: Remove blocking buffer (do not wash). Apply primary antibody diluted in blocking buffer. Incubate in a humidified chamber to prevent drying. Can incubate at RT for 2 h or 4°C overnight.
equipment: Humidified chamber (or Parafilm-covered box with wet paper towel)
steps.notes: Keep coverslips/wells covered and protected from drying. Overnight 4°C incubation usually gives lower background and stronger signal.
steps.warnings: Drying of the coverslip will cause autofluorescence and background.

steps.title: Wash off primary antibody
steps.description: Wash 3 times with PBST (PBS + 0.05% Tween-20) to remove unbound primary antibody. Each wash: 5 min on rocker.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.description: Apply fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibody diluted in blocking buffer. Protect from light. Incubate on rocker.

reagents.name: Fluorescent secondary antibody (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rabbit, Cy3 anti-mouse)

steps.notes: Secondary antibody must match the host species of primary antibody (e.g., if primary is from rabbit, use anti-rabbit secondary). Keep in dark throughout.
steps.warnings: Fluorophores photobleach — protect from light from this step onwards.

steps.title: Wash off secondary antibody
steps.description: Wash 3 times with PBST, protecting from light. Each wash: 5 min on rocker.

steps.title: Nuclear stain (DAPI or Hoechst)
steps.description: Stain nuclei with DAPI or Hoechst 33342 diluted in PBS. Incubate briefly, then wash once with PBS.
steps.notes: DAPI: excitation ~360 nm, emission ~460 nm (blue). Hoechst: excitation ~350 nm, emission ~460 nm.
steps.warnings: DAPI is a potential mutagen. Handle with gloves.

steps.title: Mount coverslip
steps.description: Rinse coverslips once more with PBS. Remove excess moisture by touching the edge to tissue. Mount on glass slide using anti-fade mounting medium. Seal edges with clear nail polish after medium cures.

reagents.name: Anti-fade mounting medium (e.g., ProLong Gold, Fluoromount-G)

steps.notes: Avoid air bubbles. Invert coverslip onto slide gently. Let cure at RT in the dark for 30 min to overnight before sealing.

steps.title: Image by fluorescence microscopy
steps.description: Acquire images on a confocal or widefield fluorescence microscope using appropriate filter sets. Adjust laser/lamp intensity and exposure to minimize photobleaching.
steps.notes: Include negative controls (no primary antibody). Acquire all channels at same settings for consistent quantification.
